decisions.decision: Scope new styles with .jn (join) and .lb (lobby) wrapper classes on top of .setup
decisions.why: Shared .setup/.plist/.pl/.av must not change elsewhere; rejected editing base rules

decisions.decision: Entrance animation only for new rows via a module-level lobbySeen Set in lobbyHTML
decisions.why: render() rebuilds innerHTML each push so CSS-only would replay on all rows (AC-3.4); rejected animation-delay approach

decisions.decision: Offline rows dimmed via bg/avatar grayscale/muted name, not row opacity
decisions.why: Opacity would drop --mut tag below 4.5:1 contrast

decisions.decision: Lobby list single column at all widths; count chip and wait text placed above list
decisions.why: AC-2.4 needs wait message visible at 360x640 with 6 players; 2-col rejected for readability

decisions.decision: No design system created, no canvas publish
decisions.why: Per task: derive tokens from style.css; ui-only

summary: design.md before/after for join + lobby, all AC-n with states, motion and reduced-motion.
